scripts.setup:api: python3.12 -m venv storage/local/base-dev-venv && storage/local/base-dev-venv/bin/python -m pip install -r apps/api/requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check:public-safety && npm run check:release-readiness && npm run check:weapp
scripts.check:weapp: npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/miniprogram && npm run test:weapp && npm run build:weapp
scripts.check:market-data: npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/market-data && npm run test -w @portfolio/market-data
scripts.package:weapp: npm run check:weapp && npm run package -w @portfolio/miniprogram
scripts.check:ai-gateway: npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/ai-gateway && npm run test -w @portfolio/ai-gateway && npm run build -w @portfolio/ai-gateway
